item.title: Global Event: SSHole (CVE-2026-123158) Live Activity Report
item.description: GreyNoise is monitoring scanning, exploitation attempts, and successful exploitation of CVE-2026-123158, also known as "SSHole," a flaw in OpenSSH on musl-based Linux (such as Alpine) that lets an oversized password authenticate to accounts configured to reject password logins.

item.title: Global Event: PHP2SHELL Live Activity Report
item.description: GreyNoise is monitoring exploitation attempts against PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, colloquially known as 'php2shell'.

item.title: skynox7: Proxyjacking Edge Devices Into Residential Proxies
item.description: How a live GreyNoise product demo turned into an incident response. Inside a proxyjacking campaign that hit 143 devices across 34 countries.
